description: Outside tag for non-entity text, grammar, punctuation, filler, and other text that is not part of an agricultural concept span.

description: Geographic locations, countries, regions, towns, villages, fields, farms, or administrative places.

description: Quantity, volume, weight, dosage, bags, or measurable amount. Include the full measurement unit in the span, including compound units such as `ကီလိုဂရမ်`.

example: ၃၀ဒီဂရီစင်တီဂရိတ်, ၈၅ဒီဂရီဖာရင်ဟိုက်
